platform_configuration.note: Repository behavior only. The existing platform automation settings remain untouched.

bootstrap.rule: After invocation start, resolve note main through a SHA-only Git ref lookup, fetch DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE at that SHA, repeat the SHA-only lookup immediately before the first task/source semantic read, and freeze the tuple. On any presemantic ordering defect emit only a gate-local diagnostic receipt.

task_selection.rule: Choose the highest-priority pending task whose idempotency key has no completed result. Revalidate every source path/blob at the frozen SHA. Execute no more than one task.
task_selection.empty_queue_fallback: Materialize and execute one bounded mechanical maintenance task from automation_control/OPTIMIZER_STATE.json exact_next_action, or run one non-duplicative gate queue/state/receipt integrity sweep for a source tuple not already checked.
task_selection.duplicate_rule: Do not repeat a completed idempotency key or emit a duplicate all-clear for an unchanged source tuple.

execution_preference: Work handoff only when the task explicitly permits it and direct execution is demonstrably insufficient

o_boundary.o_read_rule: Do not read O unless a selected gate-owned task has an explicit collision/safety need immediately before a possible side effect. No current seeded task requires O access.
